body:
Source: GitHub issue #588 (bug, P1-high, false-green). Re-verified on main @ de8a130a: packages/build-gate/bin/build-gate.mjs:119-131 reads the `--transcript` file and sets `depth`/`sessionBytes` from `computeDepthSignal({ text })`; a file that exists but yields zero recognizable tool calls (empty, truncated/rotated, compacted, or an unrecognized format) gives depth 0, and the gate reports `degraded: false, decision: 'allow'` with the same reason text as a genuinely fresh session (`the context-fitness signal is not degraded (below threshold)`). Repro at HEAD with a high-risk ticket: `--transcript <empty file>` → depth 0 / bytes 0 / allow / exit 0; `--transcript <1.2 MB base64 junk>` → depth 0 / allow / exit 0. docs/specs/build-gate-fitness.md `## Known limitations` (:78-86) states the hook path fails CLOSED on an unreadable transcript because `an unverifiable session must not be allowed through`; the CLI does not carry that rule for the readable-but-empty case.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/build-gate` is ENFORCEMENT tier: a clean same-model P5 is not sufficient; the parent handles the cross-model attestation ceremony — your job is to report `tier-check`'s exact `git-change:<base>:<digest>` line and which reviewer family reviewed the final commit. Layout: bin/build-gate.mjs (flag parsing; the transcript block :119-131; `computeRiskTier(ticket)` → `{tier, signals}`; `isDegraded`; `decideBuildGate`; the `output` object :156-170), lib/depth-signal.mjs (`countToolCalls(text)`, `computeDepthSignal({text, bytes})` → `{depth, bytes}`, `isDegraded`, thresholds), lib/risk.mjs (computeRiskTier — RAIL, read only), lib/decide.mjs (decideBuildGate — RAIL). Tests: `npm test -w packages/build-gate`; test/cli.test.mjs and test/depth-signal.test.mjs are NOT rails and may change; test/fixtures/ holds transcripts to copy. Callers of the bin whose exit-code expectations you must re-run read-only: `grep -rn "build-gate" packages/fleet/lib packages/autopilot/lib packages/runner/lib --include=*.mjs | grep -v "^packages/build-gate"` then run those packages' tests (`node --test packages/<pkg>/test/*.test.mjs`). The PreToolUse plugin hooks inline their own copy of this logic and are OUT of scope.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. ONE exported pure function in lib/depth-signal.mjs, `classifyTranscriptSignal(sig)` → `'measured'` when `sig.depth > 0`, else `'degenerate'` (zero recognizable tool calls regardless of byte size). Pure, no I/O.
2. In the bin, when `--transcript` was supplied, no explicit `--depth` was given, and the signal is `degenerate`: for a ticket whose risk tier is high, exit 1 (operational error) with the message `could not derive a context signal from <path>: no recognizable tool calls (empty, truncated, compacted, or an unrecognized transcript format) — refusing to treat an unmeasured session as fresh`. For a ticket that is not high-risk, decide allow as today but with `reason` = `no context signal could be derived from the transcript; the ticket is not high-risk so nothing is gated` and the JSON gains `signalSource: 'transcript-empty'`.
3. The JSON output always carries `signalSource`: `'flags'` when `--depth` or `--session-bytes` set the values (explicit flags win over a transcript, as today), `'transcript'` when derived from a transcript with depth > 0, `'transcript-empty'` per item 2, and `'none'` when neither was supplied (today's `defaults to not degraded` rule, unchanged). The human one-line output appends `[signal: <signalSource>]`.
4. Regression guards: a measured transcript (depth > 0) behaves exactly as today in decision, reason and exit code; `--depth`/`--session-bytes` behave exactly as today; the bypass env and its override record are untouched; a missing or unreadable transcript file is still exit 1 with the existing messages.
5. Documentation: `packages/build-gate/README.md` (flag table :32 and the paragraph at :46) and by hand `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/build-gate.mdx` (:36): a transcript with no recognizable tool calls is `could not measure` — exit 1 for a high-risk ticket, an allow with `signalSource: transcript-empty` otherwise; document the `signalSource` field. `docs/specs/build-gate-fitness.md` Known limitations: one sentence noting the CLI now carries the same rule.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 High-risk fixture ticket + `--transcript <empty file>` → exit 1, stderr contains `could not derive a context signal`; same with a 1 MB unrecognized-format file. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/transcript-degenerate.test.mjs`
- AC2 Non-high-risk fixture ticket + `--transcript <empty file> --json` → exit 0, `decision: 'allow'`, `signalSource: 'transcript-empty'`, reason contains `not high-risk`. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/transcript-degenerate.test.mjs`
- AC3 High-risk ticket + a transcript fixture with real tool calls below threshold → exit 0, `signalSource: 'transcript'`, the existing `below threshold` reason (regression); with `--depth 999` alongside an empty transcript → `signalSource: 'flags'` and the depth-driven decision. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/transcript-degenerate.test.mjs`
- AC4 `classifyTranscriptSignal` table: `{depth:0, bytes:0}` and `{depth:0, bytes:900000}` → degenerate; `{depth:1, bytes:10}` → measured; pure. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/transcript-degenerate.test.mjs`
- AC5 No `--transcript` and no flags → `signalSource: 'none'` and today's allow (unchanged). verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/transcript-degenerate.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green (rewrite any cli test that pinned the old reason text on an empty transcript and name it in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/build-gate`
- AC7 Callers found by the grep in CONTEXT stay green with no edits. verify: the `node --test` commands for each caller package found
- AC8 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "signalSource" packages/build-gate/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/build-gate.mdx` (each >= 1) and `grep -c "could not measure\|no recognizable tool calls" docs/specs/build-gate-fitness.md` (>= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)
- AC10 `node packages/prosecute/bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs tier-check --author-provider anthropic --base origin/main` in the worktree after the final commit reports TRUST-ROOT and prints the `git-change:<base>:<digest>` string; quoted verbatim in the PR body. verify: the command above

OUT OF SCOPE: recognizing more transcript formats in countToolCalls, the plugin hooks' inline copies (claude-code, codex, copilot, cursor), lib/risk.mjs and lib/decide.mjs, #587 (CHANGELOG), the bytes-only degraded path.
title: build-gate: a --transcript that yields no tool calls is "could not measure", never a definitive allow for a high-risk ticket
